Hi Anna — thanks for sending the PO and VAT cert. Quick acknowledgement: we can support entity-level invoicing but need to validate tax routing with Legal/Finance.

Operationally, two paths we can consider:

1) Conditional Net60 for the pilot: credit approved up front (subject to documentation) with staged invoices (25% upfront deposit, milestone billing, then final balance).
2) Shorter initial term (Net30/45) with an agreed review after 30–60 days and an explicit ramp to Net60 once payment performance is proven.

To evaluate path (1) we need: company credit references or an incoming credit report (Dun & Bradstreet or similar), signed SOW, and an initial deposit (we usually ask 20–30%). If Clearmark can commit a PO and a 25% deposit, finance may approve Net60 for 90 days.
